description: Réglementation : activités nautiques autour de l'île de Port-Cros is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer takes over the prefectural order N°189/2017 regulating navigation, anchoring of ships, scuba diving and the practice of speed water sports in the coastal strip of 600 mothers around the islands of Port-Cros, Bagaud and their islets (commune of Hyères-Les-Palmiers). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Regulation: nautical activities around the island of Port-Cros" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Île de Port-Cros, Navigation maritime, Protection. The listing shows 2018-10-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
